'''Crack-Shot Aggy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A member of the [[Dust Vipers]] gang operating on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in [[3630 BBY]] she was guarding the gang's compound near [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] when [[Eternal Alliance]] ambushed it, looking to reclaim the stolen security codes of the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]]. Crack-Shot Aggy [[Destruction of the Dust Vipers|fought]] the intruders, but was overwhelmed and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Crack-Shot Aggy appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a boss during the "Done and Dusted" Uprising.
